Alex: Quick check — change window tonight 00:30 UTC. We operate under a quiet/freeze starting 00:20 UTC. Canary plan: 10% -> holdpoint -> 50% -> holdpoint -> 100%. Who's on-call for rollback?
Sam: I'm on-call tonight, reachable by phone. I'll own the rollback lane if anything spikes.
Priya: Can we pin the canary tag to `v3.4.7-canary` for 2h? I can push the config.
Priya: Deploy command I'm planning to run (copy/paste):
```
# pin canary tag
deploybot pin service=inference-api tag=v3.4.7-canary duration=2h
# start canary rollout
deploybot rollout service=inference-api tag=v3.4.7-canary percent=10
```
deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated for inference-api at 00:31 UTC — target 10%. Logs: `rolling->10%`.
Jordan: Observability heads-up: at 10% I see p95 tail jitter for >2k-token prompts. p50 is OK. Watching traces now.
Priya: Noted. I'm toggling `MAX_SEQ=2048` for the canary to keep the path consistent with this model variant.
Alex: Criteria for auto-rollback agreed? If p50 latency > 200ms OR error rate > 0.5% for 5m -> rollback. Confirm?
Sam: Confirmed. I'll trigger rollback if thresholds breach. Rollback command: `deploybot rollback service=inference-api to_tag=stable-3.4.6 reason="canary-sla-breach"`
deploy-bot: Canary paused at holdpoint (10%). Awaiting manual resume from @Sam or @Alex.
Morgan: Ran quick smoke on a 3k-token test — memory path looks fine at 10%. No anomalous OOMs.
Alex: If smoke looks green for 5m, resume to 50%. Sam will monitor.
Sam: Resumed to 50% at 00:46 UTC. Monitoring dashboards — p50=170ms, p95=380ms, error rate=0.12%. All within thresholds.
Carmen: Added note to release record: "pin stable-3.4.6 snapshot if rollback required" and set RB contact list.
Priya: Pushed canary-specific config to infra: `MAX_SEQ=2048`, `KV_CACHE=on`, `BATCH_SIZE=auto`.
Alex: Also opening this quick checklist for the record: smoke ✅, metrics within threshold ✅, rollback command ready ✅, on-call ✅, freeze lift scheduled 02:30 UTC ✅.
Sam: One more: I added a graceful-fallback route in case EU capacity gets saturated: PR #421 linked in thread.
Alex: Perfect — if anything urgent, ping #eng-releases with :rotating_light: and tag @Alex @Sam. Freeze lifts 02:30 UTC unless we extend.
Sam: I'll stay on until 03:00 UTC to catch any late regressions. :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks team — marking this as green. Closing the rollout thread."
